environment.description: FastAPI service running on ECS Fargate in a private subnet. The service has an IAM role with s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::app-session-store-prod/*. S3 access goes through a gateway VPC endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e) with a default policy allowing all actions. The /admin/upload-session endpoint is exposed internally with no authentication. Any internal service can upload arbitrary pickle payloads to the session bucket.
